title: DAC command quantizer
description: Uses DAC.quantize from converter experiments: requested analog command → integer code and quantized voltage. LSB=(v_max−v_min)/(2^bits−1). No jitter, DNL or INL model.

params.name: bits
params.description: Integer resolution; rounds to nearest code with NumPy ties-to-even.

params.name: v_min
params.description: Converter lower endpoint. Must be less than v_max.

params.name: clip
params.description: False rejects out-of-range commands; true explicitly clips to converter rails.
